title: Kabandha advises Rama to meet Sugreeva
introduction: When Rama incinerates Kabandha he resurrects as a celestial being and detailing about Sugreeva he urges Rama to befriend him. He informs Rama that Sugreeva is also in a similar condition and he needs some one to rely upon, in order to overcome his problems, and thus Kabandha asks Rama to help Sugreeva, and get help as requital from Sugreeva.
closing: Kabandha's suggestion that 'a bewailer shall befriend another bewailer...' is apparently a meaningless suggestion, keeping mythical imports aside, for a while. Though Kabandha is unaware about Ravana and his activities, he is aware of Vali and Sugreeva, according to his present narration. He should have advised Rama to befriend Vali, who is in power and a powerful one too, instead of Sugreeva. It is not so, is the reply from the viewpoint of dharma. This Kabandha has suffered his best in taking wrong routes and just now, he resurrected after making many amends, and he is supposed to advise Rama to go on a right path and to a right personality as Vali is already established as a pursuer of wrong path. But Vali when talking to Rama at his death time says that 'I would have brought Maithili in a single day, I would have roped Ravana and brought him like an animal tide with roe around its neck...' etc. But they are all his expressions at death-time-wisdom. He did not care for Tara's advices nor bothered to talk to Rama, as to why Sugreeva is instigated upon him. This being so, when immortal wisdom has dawned on Kabandha, he cannot ask Rama to tread a wrong path to get his task done. This is what the viewpoint of Dharmaakuutam. Though untranslated verbatim the above is the gist of the following.

kārya siddi artham samprati bhātru mātra sahāyyasya durdaśa ārambaham prāptasya rāmabhadrasya dṛṣṭa balena daiva balena ca upeta durdaśāyāḥ samāpti prāptena sugrīveṇa sandhi kārama eva samucitam iti kabandhena uktam | tat anupapannam | yato valī sugrīvāt adhika balaḥ - sakala vānara senā pari vṛtaḥ - sva rājye supratiṣṭito - rāma kṛta prati upakāra nirapekṣo - rāvaṇa nigraha catura bhuja vīrya upapatteh ca | mām eva yadi pūrvam tvam etad artham acodayaḥ | maithilim aham eka āhnā tava ca ānītavān bhaveḥ || 1-17-49 | rākṣasam ca durātmānām tava bhārya apahāriṇam | kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyām te anihatam rāvaṇam raṇe || 3-17-50 - iti jīva grāham gṛhītvā raṇe vā tan nihatya - - etādṛśa sāmarthyam avagamane sva kārya sādhakaḥ ca | ata eva vālinam apahāya atādṛśaḥ sugrīvaḥ katham upadiṣṭa iti cet na | satya api sāmardhye dṛptavān - rāvaṇa mitratvāt rājya sthitatvāt - rāma kṛta upakāra nirapekṣatvāt ca rāma prāthito vālī sakhyam na angīkuryād eva | āsanna mṛtunā vālinā sakhya karaṇam niṣphalam ca || - - - satyapi sāmardhye sītām ānīya dāsyāmi iti etādṛśa buddheḥ śikṣaṇa anantara bhavitvena sakhya asakhyāyām asambhavāt | sva parākrameṇa vinā anyena sādhita artha angīkaraṇasya kṣatriyāṇām adharmyatvāt |

This is to say that dharma is far beyond mere politics, whether monarchical or otherwise. To uphold that dharma, one has to undergo certain painful processes, that may be you, or we, or may they be godlike or godsend Rama or Lakshmana.
इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे द्वि सप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 72nd chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the first Epic poem of India

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तौ तु तौ वीरौ कबन्धेन नर ईश्वरौ |
गिरि प्रदरम् आसाद्य पावकम् विससर्जतुः
verses.iast:
evam uktau tu tau vīrau kabandhena nara īśvarau |
giri pradaram āsādya pāvakam visasarjatuḥ
verses.translation: When Kabandha said that way, both those brave men and lords of people, on throwing the body of Kabandha into a mountain cleft and then embedded it with firewood.

glosses.meaning: that way, those two who are said
mountain, cleft, on getting at [throwing the body of Kabandha in it]

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणः तु महा उल्काभिः ज्वलिताभिः समन्ततः |
चिताम् आदीपयामास सा प्रजज्वाल सर्वतः
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ tu mahā ulkābhiḥ jvalitābhiḥ samantataḥ |
citām ādīpayāmāsa sā prajajvāla sarvataḥ
verses.translation: On his part Lakshmana started to torch that pyre with highly sparkling torches from all over, and even that pyre too suddenly blazed with blazes from all over.

verses.devanagari:
तत् शरीरम् कबन्धस्य घृत पिण्ड उपमम् महत् |
मेदसा पच्यमानस्य मन्दम् दहति पावकः
verses.iast:
tat śarīram kabandhasya ghṛta piṇḍa upamam mahat |
medasā pacyamānasya mandam dahati pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: That massy body of Kabandha is full with fat and while it is being cooked, it is in simile with a massy gob of ghee. But the Fire had to stew that body tardily, though that stewed meat is Fire's favourite dish, because of that body's massiveness.

glosses.meaning: while being cooked - being burnt in fire
fire, tardily, burnt it [stewed the body.]

verses.devanagari:
स विधूय चिताम् आशु विधूमो अग्निर् इव उत्थितः |
अरजे वाससी बिभ्रत् मालाम् दिव्याम् महाबलः
verses.iast:
sa vidhūya citām āśu vidhūmo agnir iva utthitaḥ |
araje vāsasī bibhrat mālām divyām mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: In a trice that highly dynamic Kabandha zoomed up shoving off that pyre, and he is now attired in lily-white vestments and angelic garlands, and appeared like a fumeless fire.

glosses.meaning: without, fumes, fire, alike [looks like,] zoomed.

verses.devanagari:
ततः चिताया वेगेन भास्वरो विरज अंबरः |
उत्पपात आशु संहृष्टः सर्व प्रत्यंग भूषणः
verses.iast:
tataḥ citāyā vegena bhāsvaro viraja ambaraḥ |
utpapāta āśu saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sarva pratyaṃga bhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then highly gladdened Kabandha jumped up onto sky from the pyre, and there he is irradiant with unsullied clothing, and fineries decorated on every limb.

glosses.meaning: on all, every, limb, with fineries

verses.devanagari:
विमाने भास्वरे तिष्ठन् हंस युक्ते यशस् करे |
प्रभया च महातेजा दिशो दश विराजयन्
सो अन्तरिक्ष गतो वाक्यम् कबन्धो रामम् अब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
vimāne bhāsvare tiṣṭhan haṃsa yukte yaśas kare |
prabhayā ca mahātejā diśo daśa virājayan
so antarikṣa gato vākyam kabandho rāmam abravīt |
verses.translation: On going to firmament Kabandha is now seated in a dazzling celestial aircraft yoked with swans, which endows renown because it takes the occupants to the realms of Brahma, and sitting in that celestial aircraft he said this sentence to Rama, while his own great glimmer and glitter beamed forth in all ten quarters.

glosses.meaning: glitter also [additional self-refulgence, added now by the sacred incineration by Rama, or by the glitter of heavenly aircraft]

verses.devanagari:
शृणु राघव तत्त्वेन यथा सीमाम् अवाप्स्यसि
राम षड् युक्तयो लोके याभिः सर्वम् विमृश्यते |
परिमृष्टो दश अन्तेन दश आभागेन सेव्यते
verses.iast:
śṛṇu rāghava tattvena yathā sīmām avāpsyasi
rāma ṣaḍ yuktayo loke yābhiḥ sarvam vimṛśyate |
parimṛṣṭo daśa antena daśa ābhāgena sevyate
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava, how you will regain Seetha, that you listen from me in its essence... oh, Rama, by which and which analyses everything will be analysed, six of such ideations are available in this world... and when a person is touched down by a spell of nemeses, he shall adore one who is equally in such spell of nemesis...
notes: The six ideations employed by kings in kingship are 1] sandhi a covenant with adverse kings; 2] vigraha continuing hostilities; 3] yāna waging war; 4] āsana sit out for proper time; 5] dvaidhī bhāva creating factions and vicissitudes in enemy groups; 6] samāśraya taking shelter under a coequal.

glosses.meaning: on who is touched down [with such nemesis]
spell, one deprived of [under the spell of nemesis]

verses.devanagari:
दश आभाग गतो हीनः त्वम् राम सह लक्ष्मणः |
यत् कृते व्यसनम् प्राप्तम् त्वया दार प्रधर्षणम्
verses.iast:
daśa ābhāga gato hīnaḥ tvam rāma saha lakṣmaṇaḥ |
yat kṛte vyasanam prāptam tvayā dāra pradharṣaṇam
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, you along with Lakshmana went into a spell of nemesis, and thus you have become an underprivileged one, and that spell alone has obtained you this dire straits, in the form of abducting your wife...

glosses.meaning: by which, doing [reason, that spell has done this]

verses.devanagari:
तत् अवश्यम् त्वया कार्यः स सुहृत् सुहृदाम् वर |
अकृत्वा न हि ते सिद्धिम् अहम् पश्यामि चिन्तयन्
verses.iast:
tat avaśyam tvayā kāryaḥ sa suhṛt suhṛdām vara |
akṛtvā na hi te siddhim aham paśyāmi cintayan
verses.translation: "Oh, best among kind-hearted ones, thereby you have to certainly befriend such a soul in similar dire straits... however deeply I may think, I am not able to perceive your accomplishment if you do not befriended with such a soul...

glosses.meaning: such a soul [in similar dire straits]

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयताम् राम वक्ष्यामि सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः |
भ्रात्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन वालिना शक्र सूनुना
verses.iast:
śrūyatām rāma vakṣyāmi sugrīvo nāma vānaraḥ |
bhrātrā nirastaḥ kruddhena vālinā śakra sūnunā
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, listen what I tell... a vanara is there by name Sugreeva, who is vengefully reneged by his brother Vali, the son of Indra...

glosses.meaning: oh, Rama, I tell, that may be listened

verses.devanagari:
ऋष्यमूके गिरि वरे पंपा पर्यन्त शोभिते |
निवसति आत्मवान् वीरः चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः
verses.iast:
ṛṣyamūke giri vare pampā paryanta śobhite |
nivasati ātmavān vīraḥ caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ
verses.translation: "That self-respectful valiant Sugreeva is living on the Mt. Rishyamuka, a best mountain available in the lambent fringes of Pampa Lake, along with four other vanara-s.

glosses.meaning: with four, [other] vanara-s, along with nivasati = is living.

verses.devanagari:
वानरेन्द्रो महावीर्यः तेजोवान् अमित प्रभः |
सत्य संधो विनीतः च धृतिमान् मतिमान् महान्
verses.iast:
vānarendro mahāvīryaḥ tejovān amita prabhaḥ |
satya saṃdho vinītaḥ ca dhṛtimān matimān mahān
verses.translation: "He that Sugreeva is a masterful one among vanara-s, highly mettlesome, self-resplendent, and illimitable is his self-radiance... and he is also truth-bound and culture-bound... a mastermind, master-hand and a taskmaster...

verses.devanagari:
दक्षः प्रगल्भो द्युतिमान् महा बल पराक्रमः |
भ्राता विवासितो वीर राज्य हेतो महात्मना
verses.iast:
dakśaḥ pragalbho dyutimān mahā bala parākramaḥ |
bhrātā vivāsito vīra rājya heto mahātmanā
verses.translation: "He is a capable adventurer, a courageous exploiter and incomparable one in intrepidity and a brave one in incursions, and his personality will be coruscating ever and anon, for he is the son of Sun-god... but he is banished by his self-conceited brother owing to the reasons of kingdom...

verses.devanagari:
स ते सहायो मित्रम् च सीतायाः परिमार्गणे |
भविष्यति हि ते राम मा च शोके मनः कृधाः
verses.iast:
sa te sahāyo mitram ca sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe |
bhaviṣyati hi te rāma mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛdhāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, he will be your associate and an aid in searching for Seetha, and he conducts himself in your wellbeing, hence let not your heart yield to agony...

glosses.meaning: in agony, heart, do not, do [yield.]

verses.devanagari:
भवितव्यम् हि यत् च अपि न तत् शक्यम् इह अन्यथा |
कर्तुम् इक्ष्वाकु शार्दूल कालो हि दुर्रक्रमः
verses.iast:
bhavitavyam hi yat ca api na tat śakyam iha anyathā |
kartum ikśvāku śārdūla kālo hi durrakramaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, tigerly Ikshvaaku, further nothing can be countermanded in this world which is indeed ineluctable, and it is impossible to countervail against Time, isn't it...

glosses.meaning: now / here in mortal world, ineluctable, indeed
that, otherwise, to do [to be countermanded]
Time, impossible, to over, step [countervail against]

verses.devanagari:
गच्छ शीघ्रम् इतो वीर सुग्रीवम् तम् महाबलम् |
वयस्यम् तम् कुरु क्षिप्रम् इतो गत्वा अद्य राघव
अद्रोहाय समागम्य दीप्यमाने विभावसौ |
verses.iast:
gaccha śīghram ito vīra sugrīvam tam mahābalam |
vayasyam tam kuru kṣipram ito gatvā adya rāghava
adrohāya samāgamya dīpyamāne vibhāvasau |
verses.translation: "Oh, bold one, you go straight from here to that great mighty Sugreeva, and oh, Raghava, on going from here now and promptly you fraternise with Sugreeva... and to not to bode any ill of unfriendliness among you two, you make him a friend before blazing Fire, making that Fire as an Attestor of your friendship...

glosses.meaning: to him, great, mighty, Sugreeva, you go
now, from here, promptly, on going
him, as a friend, you make.

verses.devanagari:
न च ते सो अवमन्तव्यः सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः
कृतज्ञः काम रूपी च सहाय अर्थी च वीर्यवान् |
verses.iast:
na ca te so avamantavyaḥ sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ
kṛtaGYaḥ kāma rūpī ca sahāya arthī ca vīryavān |
verses.translation: "You shall not look down on that lord of monkeys taking him as a lowly simian, why because that Sugreeva is a valiant one, a guise changing wizard and presently he is in the need of a bolsterer, and if you render help he will be obligated to you for ever...

glosses.meaning: even if he is a monkey]

verses.devanagari:
शक्तौ हि अद्य युवाम् कर्तुम् कार्यम् तस्य चिकीर्षितम्
कृतार्थो वा अकृतार्थो वा तव कृत्यम् करिष्यति |
verses.iast:
śaktau hi adya yuvām kartum kāryam tasya cikīrṣitam
kṛtārtho vā akṛtārtho vā tava kṛtyam kariṣyati |
verses.translation: "Now you two are capable enough to effectuate the desired task of Sugreeva, isn't it... whether his own purpose is achieved through you or not, he will effectuate your task...

glosses.meaning: achieved, his purpose, whether - Sugreeva is
not, achieved, his purpose, or not

verses.devanagari:
स ऋक्षरजसः पुत्रः पंपाम् अटति शन्कितः
भास्करस्य औरसः पुत्रो वालिना कृत किल्बिषः |
verses.iast:
sa ṛkṣarajasaḥ putraḥ pampām aṭati śankitaḥ
bhāskarasya aurasaḥ putro vālinā kṛta kilbiṣaḥ |
verses.translation: "Sugreeva is the son of Riksharaja, and the direct son of the Sun, but Vali trespassed against him. Wary of Vali's onslaughts Sugreeva is wandering around Pampa...

verses.devanagari:
संनिधाय आयुधम् क्षिप्रम् ऋष्यमूक आलयम् कपिम्
कुरु राघव सत्येन वयस्यम् वन चारिणम् |
verses.iast:
saṃnidhāya āyudham kṣipram ṛṣyamūka ālayam kapim
kuru rāghava satyena vayasyam vana cāriṇam |
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava, right away and candidly you make that monkey Sugreeva, a wanderer in the forest, sheltering himself on Mt. Rishyamuka, as a friend of yours taking an oath on your weapon besides the Fire-witness...
notes: The compound āyudham sam ni dhāya can mean in the three possible ways as said above. Any one, or three meanings can be obtained, as intensifiers.

glosses.meaning: readying / keeping aside / taking oath on it

verses.devanagari:
स हि स्थानानि सर्वाणि कार्त्स्न्येन कपि कुंजरः
नर मांस अशिनाम् लोके नैपुण्यात् अधिगच्छति |
verses.iast:
sa hi sthānāni sar.hvāṇi kār.htsnyena kapi kuṃjaraḥ
nara māṃsa aśinām loke naipuṇyāt adhigacchati |
verses.translation: "With his expertise that straightforward monkey Sugreeva is indeed conversant with all of the strongholds of anthropophagite demons in the world in their entirety...

glosses.meaning: monkey, elephantine - straightforward one among monkeys

verses.devanagari:
न तस्य अविदितम् लोके किंचित् अस्ति हि राघव
यावत् सूर्यः प्रतपति सहस्रांशुः अरिन्दम |
verses.iast:
na tasya aviditam loke kiṃcit asti hi rāghava
yāvat sūryaḥ pratapati sahasrāṃśuḥ arindama |
verses.translation: "Oh, enemy-subjugator Rama, as far as the thousand rayed sun manifestly irradiates the world, oh, Raghava, thus far, nothing in the least is unfamiliar to him, isn't it...

verses.devanagari:
स नदीः विपुलान् शैलान् गिरि दुर्गाणि कंदरान्
अन्विष्य वानरैः सार्धम् पत्नीम् ते अधिगमिष्यति |
verses.iast:
sa nadīḥ vipulān śailān giri dur.hgāṇi kaṃdarān
anviṣya vānaraiḥ sārdham patnīm te adhigamiṣyati |
verses.translation: "He makes the monkeys to purposefully rake over the expansive rivers, extensive mountains and their impassable cliffs and caves in locating your wife...

glosses.meaning: he that Sugreeva, with vanara-s, purposefully
your, wife, he comes to know.

verses.devanagari:
वानरान् च महाकायान् प्रेषयिष्यति राघव
दिशो विचेतुम् ताम् सीताम् त्वत् वियोगेन शोचयतीम् |
अन्वेष्यति वरारोहाम् मैथिलीम् रावण आलये
verses.iast:
vānarān ca mahākāyān preṣayiṣyati rāghava
diśo vicetum tām sītām tvat viyogena śocayatīm |
anveṣyati varārohām maithilīm rāvaṇa ālaye
verses.translation: "Oh, Raghava, he expedites giant bodied monkeys in all directions to search for her, who is agonised by your parting, and he quests after the residence of Ravana for that comely lady Maithili...

verses.devanagari:
स मेरु शृंग अग्र गताम् अनिंदिताम्
प्रविश्य पाताल तले अपि वा आश्रिताम् |
प्लवंगमानाम् ऋषभः तव प्रियाम्
निहत्य रक्षांसि पुनः प्रदास्यति
verses.iast:
sa meru śṛṃga agra gatām aniṃditām
praviśya pātāla tale api vā āśritām |
plavaṃgamānām ṛṣabhaḥ tava priyām
nihatya rakṣāṃsi punaḥ pradāsyati
verses.translation: "Whether that unreprovable ladylove of yours, Seetha, is located on the tops of Mt. Meru's peaks, or abiding on the planes of nadir of the earth, he that defiant one among fly-jumpers, Sugreeva, on entering there and annihilating the demons, he again bestows Seetha to you..." So Kabandha continued his advise to Rama regarding Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: Mt. Meru's, peak's, top, gone onto [located]
nadir of earth, on planes, abiding
again he will, bestow [Seetha to you.]
